consumer_receipts.input_provenance: Synthetic public schema/example shapes; no customer data or captured private application payloads. Consumer functions are exact source snapshots; imports are supplied by the benchmark.

scope: Exact synchronous Consumer consumer function slices over labelled synthetic fixture inputs; fixture setup and profiles excluded. Example models project only attributes read by captured functions. This is not full app/network/LLM/database latency.
method: adjacent alternating wall/thread CPU batches; independent equally seeded engines and consumer inputs; exact outputs and complete internal RNG states; separate cProfile RNG fraction and precomputed masking-selection control
